app.name: KisanNiti
app.tagline: Fair selling plans for Farmer Producer Organizations
app.description: Decision support for FPO post-harvest selling

status.title: System status
status.demoBanner: {mode} — fictional FPO data; not real farmers

issues.NOT_READY: the database structure does not match the latest code

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Quote the reference when you report it.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Try again.
errors.csrf: The page is out of date. Reload it and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the account your FPO administrator gave you.
signIn.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
signIn.demoNote: This is a demonstration with fictional accounts.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.intro: You must set a new password before you continue.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
changePassword.weak: This password is not acceptable. Avoid common passwords and your username, and use at least 10 characters.
changePassword.hint: At least 10 characters. Several ordinary words together work well.

home.soon: Prices, storage, plans and messages will appear here as they are built.

users.title: Users
users.intro: People who can sign in for your FPO. Passwords are never shown, except a temporary one, once.
users.name: Name
users.created: User created. Give this temporary password to them now; it will not be shown again.
users.confirmReset: Reset the password of {name}? They will be signed out.
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They will be signed out and cannot sign in.
users.usernameHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore; 3 to 64 characters.
users.noPermission: You do not have permission to manage users.

members.title: Members
members.intro: The farmers of your FPO. Contact details come later, with the consent controls.
members.name: Name
members.noWrite: You can view members but not change them.

lots.title: Lots and stock
lots.intro: Each lot is one crop owned by one member. The quantities come from a ledger that never rounds and never goes below zero; they cannot be typed in.
lots.refused: Refused: this would make the stock negative.
lots.badQuantity: Write the quantity with exactly three decimals, for example 1250.000.

prices.title: Market prices
prices.intro: Daily prices reported by the mandis (AGMARKNET), for Paddy(Basmati) in Punjab, and the official support prices. These are mandi-level prices, not the price a farmer received.

status.PENDING_HAND_CHECK: Not yet checked by a person

prices.pendingWarning: These prices are shown with a warning: a person has not yet compared a sample with the AGMARKNET website, and the rule for rows without a date is not yet confirmed. Do not use them for any claim yet.
prices.blankDate: Date taken from the row above
prices.noData: No price dataset has been imported yet.

flagNames.DUPLICATE_KEY: two rows for the same day

devices.title: Storage sensors
devices.intro: Each sensor sits in one place and reports temperature and humidity. The category is an experimental approximation of conditions that favour mould and insects at that one point. It is not measured spoilage.

placements.AMBIENT: In the air of the shed

reasons.NO_ASSIGNMENT: The sensor has not been placed yet.
reasons.NOT_IN_GRAIN: The sensor is not in the grain, so the grain condition cannot be judged.
reasons.SETTLING: The sensor was only just placed; the first 6 hours are ignored while it settles.
reasons.STALE: No fresh reading in the last 15 minutes.
reasons.LOW_COVERAGE: Fewer than three quarters of the expected readings arrived in the last 24 hours.

insects.INSECT_FAVOURABLE: Warm enough for insects to be active

adjust.COLD_BELOW_10C_LOWERED: Lowered one step because it is below 10 °C
adjust.WARM_25C_RAISED: Raised one step because it is 25 °C or warmer with humidity of 60% or more

devices.limits: 65% and 70% are the limits for medium and high
devices.noAssessment: No assessment yet; the job runs every hour.
devices.label: Experimental approximation, not measured spoilage
devices.confirmDeactivate: Stop accepting readings from {id}? Its history stays.
